title: L’Oréal to acquire a majority stake in Innovist, a leading digital-first Indian personal care house of brands - L'Oréal
summary: L’Oréal to acquire a majority stake in Innovist, a leading digital-first Indian personal care house of brands L'Oréal
ai_summary: L’Oréal will acquire a majority stake in Innovist, a digital-first Indian personal care house of brands. This move expands L’Oréal’s presence in the Indian market.
